motion.description: Expressions for animating position, layout, and spatial behavior.

transformation.description: Expressions that resize, scale, or reposition layers relative to comp or text bounds.

interpolation.description: Expressions for driving values from text content, counters, and derived data.

randomness.description: Expressions that introduce controlled randomness, flickering, and organic variation.

conditional.description: Expressions that branch based on layer state, time, or comp properties.

expressions.name: Animated Responsive Text Box
expressions.description: Animates the width of a shape layer based on a referenced text layer’s width. It transitions from a keyframed starting width to match the current text size.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for lower-thirds, labels, or expanding buttons that grow to fit the text inside - while still looking smooth and animated.

expressions.name: Auto Align and Center Two Text Layers
expressions.description: This expression keeps two text layers visually centered relative to each other and the composition, no matter the text length or spacing. Be sure to follow the instructions in the expression comments!
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for ensuring two text layers remain perfectly centered within the composition - especially useful for headlines and dynamic text setups where content length may vary.

expressions.name: Auto Grid Layout Expression After Effects
expressions.description: Automatically arranges shape/text layers in a responsive grid using a control layer with a "Columns" slider. Includes scale auto-fit.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for building tiled image galleries, infographic layouts, or grid-based animations.

expressions.name: Auto-Scaling Text Layer with Width Constraints
expressions.description: Automatically scales a text layer to ensure its width stays within a specified limit. The text adjusts its size dynamically to fit within the bounds, providing a responsive design solution.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for auto-scaling subtitles, banners, or text that needs to adapt to varying character counts without exceeding a defined width, ensuring consistency in responsive layouts.

expressions.name: Auto Scale to Comp
expressions.description: Automatically resizes your image, video, or precomp so it fits perfectly inside the composition. You can choose whether it should fit completely inside (no cropping) or fill the entire frame (may crop a bit). There’s also a switch to keep or ignore the original aspect ratio, so you can decide if it should stay proportional or stretch to fill the space.
expressions.whenToUse: Use this when you’re replacing footage or images in a template and want them to instantly scale to the right size without guessing. It’s great for social-media versions (square, vertical, or widescreen), product videos, or automated projects where every image needs to fit just right every time.

expressions.name: Auto-Wiggle When Near Another Layer
expressions.description: Automatically adjusts the wiggle amount based on distance to another layer.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for interactive UI animations, physics-based motion, or objects reacting when near another element.

expressions.name: Automatic Fade In and Out Expression
expressions.description: Adds a fade in and fade out effect based on layer duration, without keyframes.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for templates or MOGRTs where layers need quick fade-in/out transitions.

expressions.name: Automatic Scale Animation with Overshoot
expressions.description: Applies a smooth scale animation with an overshoot effect that dynamically adapts to the layer’s duration. The animation begins at the layer’s inPoint, peaks with an overshoot, and settles at the final scale. It then reverses the process at the outPoint, all without requiring any keyframes.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for animating elements like buttons, logos, or text, adding smooth and professional-looking scale transitions. Ideal for templates or projects where automatic, time-based scaling animations save time and effort.

expressions.name: Bell Shake & Ring Motion
expressions.description: Creates a periodic burst of high-frequency oscillation (shaking) followed by a moment of stillness. This simulates the physics of an object being struck or vibrated at specific intervals rather than moving continuously.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for animating notification icons, alarm clocks, or holiday jingle bells that need to "ring" periodically to grab the viewer's attention.

expressions.name: Bounce Expression
expressions.description: Creates a bounce effect when an object comes to rest.
expressions.whenToUse: A ball bounces to a stop after falling, using this expression to animate its bounce motion.

expressions.name: Center Anchor Point Expression
expressions.description: Calculates the center point of a text layer, based on its bounding box.
expressions.whenToUse: Aligns other elements (like icons or graphics) to the exact center of a dynamically sized text box, keeping the layout balanced.

expressions.name: Change Value Based On Position
expressions.description: Changes any value of a layer based on the position
expressions.whenToUse: Changing the opacity of a layer if it crosses a certaing position.

expressions.name: Character Counter for Text Layers
expressions.description: Counts and returns the total number of characters in a text layer, dynamically updating as the text changes.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for animations or templates where character count impacts design decisions, like creating dynamic layouts or limiting text lengths.
expressions.expression:
myText = thisComp.layer("textLayer").text.sourceText;
myText.length

expressions.name: Character Counter for Text Layers Excluding Spaces
expressions.description: Counts the number of characters in a text layer while excluding spaces, providing a more precise character count for text that may include whitespace.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for templates and animations where the number of characters, excluding spaces, plays a role in dynamic layouts, adjusting design elements, or enforcing text length limits.

expressions.name: Christmas Lights Color Generator
expressions.description: Randomly switches a layer's color between a defined holiday palette (Red, Green, Gold, White). It uses the layer's index to ensure multiple duplicates flash independently, creating a non-synchronized, organic blinking effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for animating string lights, garlands, or festive borders where you need hundreds of individual bulbs to blink randomly without manually animating each one.

expressions.name: Circular Orbit Around a Layer
expressions.description: Makes a layer orbit around another at a set speed and radius.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for animating satellites, planets, or circular motion effects.

expressions.name: Clamp Expression
expressions.description: Restricts a property’s value within a specified range.
expressions.whenToUse: Ensuring that a layer's scale never goes below 50% or above 150%, no matter what animations or adjustments you apply.
expressions.expression: clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)

expressions.name: Color Animation Based on Layer Position
expressions.description: Dynamically changes a layer’s color based on its position within the composition, using X and Y coordinates to calculate RGB values.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for interactive animations where objects change color as they move, such as sliders, maps, or responsive graphics.
expressions.expression:
xNorm = linear(position[0], 0, thisComp.width, 0, 1); // Normalize X position
yNorm = linear(position[1], 0, thisComp.height, 0, 1); // Normalize Y position
r = linear(xNorm, 0, 1, 0, 255); // Map X to Red
g = linear(yNorm, 0, 1, 0, 255); // Map Y to Green
b = 255 - (r + g) / 2; // Complementary Blue
[r, g, b, 255] / 255; // Normalize to RGB

expressions.name: Color Fade Expression
expressions.description: Fades a color from white to black over 5 seconds.
expressions.whenToUse: Fading a color from white to black over 5 seconds.

expressions.name: Constrain Shape Layer Inside Circle Bounds
expressions.description: Keeps a smaller shape layer constrained inside a larger circle by calculating and limiting its position, ensuring it stays within the boundaries.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for creating animations where smaller objects, like buttons or icons, need to move freely but stay within a circular frame.

expressions.name: Convert Spaces into Line Breaks in Text Layers
expressions.description: Replaces all spaces in a text layer with line breaks.
expressions.whenToUse: Helps format text dynamically, ensuring line breaks happen after every space - great for captions and paragraph formatting.
expressions.expression: text.sourceText.replace(/ /g, "\r");

expressions.name: ConvertToWorld Expression
expressions.description: Converts a 2D position to 3D space coordinates.
expressions.whenToUse: Aligning a spotlight’s position to the world space anchor point of another 3D object.

expressions.name: Copy Text and Style from Another Layer
expressions.description: Duplicates the text content and style from a main text layer. Automatically updates whenever the source changes.
expressions.whenToUse: Automatically mirror both text and styling from a main layer - perfect for subtitles, translated text, or synced design systems.

expressions.name: Exponential Counter Up Expression
expressions.description: Creates a scaling effect that grows exponentially.
expressions.whenToUse: You want to animate a text layer that shows a price or number increasing exponentially, simulating the effect of fast-growing numbers.
expressions.expression: "$" + Math.floor(1000 * Math.exp(time)).toString();

expressions.name: Display Current Date in After Effects
expressions.description: Shows the current date within a text layer, customizable by format.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful in dynamic date overlays or template projects where the date should auto-update.

expressions.name: Days Until Date Counter
expressions.description: Dynamically calculates the remaining time until a specific target holiday or event. It compares the current time to the target and updates the text layer automatically, even detecting if the date has passed to reset for the next year.
expressions.whenToUse: Essential for creating "Countdown to Christmas" graphics, product launch timers, or event reminders in social media templates that need to remain accurate.

expressions.name: Delay Expression
expressions.description: Delays a property’s value based on another layer's animation.
expressions.whenToUse: Delaying the rotation of a gear object so it follows the rotation of a larger parent gear.
expressions.expression: thisComp.layer(index-1).transform.rotation.valueAtTime(time - 0.5)

expressions.name: Detect Layer Overlap
expressions.description: Detects when two layers overlap, adjusting opacity as they collide.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for collision detection effects, such as interactive animations where elements change on contact.

expressions.name: Dynamic AM/PM Digital Timer Expression
expressions.description: A responsive digital timer with AM/PM formatting that updates dynamically based on the timeline, using sliders for hours, minutes, and seconds.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for motion graphics like digital clocks, dashboards, or time-based animations requiring precise and customizable time displays.

expressions.name: Digital Timer, Hours and Minutes Format
expressions.description: Displays time in an HH:MM format using a slider control.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for countdowns or time-based animations where hours and minutes are needed.

expressions.name: Digital Timer, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds Format
expressions.description: Displays time in HH:MM:SS format, customizable via a slider.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for detailed time-based animations, such as timers or digital displays.

expressions.name: Distance-Based Scale Expression
expressions.description: Scales an object based on its distance from a reference point.
expressions.whenToUse: Scales the layer based on its distance from the point [500, 500]
expressions.expression: linear(length(position, [500, 500]), 0, 1000, 100, 0)

expressions.name: Distance Between Two Layers Expression
expressions.description: Finds the straight-line distance (in pixels) between this layer and a target layer and outputs that number.
expressions.whenToUse: Drive effects like blur, opacity or scale based on how close two layers are - perfect for reactive HUDs or infographics.

expressions.name: Animated 2D DNA Helix Path
expressions.description: Creates an animated 2D DNA strand path (one strand per layer) with controls for helix height, turns, radius, depth, offset, segments, and rotation speed. The path updates in real time and simulates subtle pseudo-3D depth. To build a full double helix, duplicate the layer and set the second strand’s offset to 180.
expressions.whenToUse: Build science explainers or medical visuals by layering two customizable animated DNA strands in After Effects.

expressions.name: DVD Screensaver Bounce Effect
expressions.description: Moves a layer across the screen, bouncing off edges dynamically.
expressions.whenToUse: Recreates the classic DVD logo bounce effect for motion design, screen savers, or fun retro animations.

expressions.name: Dynamic Anchor Point Lock Expression
expressions.description: Uses sourceRectAtTime() and a dropdown menu to lock a layer’s anchor point to any of nine positions (center, corners, edges) relative to its own bounds.
expressions.whenToUse: Quickly snap a layer’s Anchor Point to any corner or the center without dragging it by hand. Great for lower-thirds and text rigs.

expressions.name: Dynamic Number Counter without Keyframes
expressions.description: This expression automatically animates a number from a defined start value to an end value over a set duration. It begins at the layer’s inPoint and allows control over the animation speed and decimal precision.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for UI animations, statistics, financial data, and countdowns where a number needs to animate smoothly without manual keyframing.

expressions.name: Dynamic Drop Shadow Based on Light Source
expressions.description: Controls Drop Shadow direction, distance, and softness based on the position of a light source.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for motion design with realistic lighting, making shadows move dynamically with light sources.

expressions.name: Dynamic Text Box
expressions.description: Dynamically adjusts the size of a text box based on the width and height of another text layer, adding padding.
expressions.whenToUse: Automatically resizes a background box to fit around changing text, ensuring consistent padding for labels, buttons, or captions.

expressions.name: Ease Expression
expressions.description: Smoothly transitions between two values over a given time.
expressions.whenToUse: Smoothly increasing opacity from 0 to 100 over 1 second for a fade effect.

expressions.name: EaseIn Expression
expressions.description: Creates a smooth animation between two values like the Ease expression but with a slower start.
expressions.whenToUse: Gradually increasing a layer’s scale from 50% to 150% over 2 seconds.
expressions.expression: easeIn(time, 0, 2, 50, 150);

expressions.name: Elastic Connection Expression for Linked Animation
expressions.description: Creates an elastic motion effect for a layer that follows another, like a spring.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for animating objects connected with a spring-like motion, like bungee cords or flexible connectors.

expressions.name: Expose Layer Speed Expression
expressions.description: Outputs a layer's movement speed (scalar) to drive effects like scaling, rotation, or blur.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for adding motion blur, elastic effects, or reactive animations tied to movement speed.
expressions.expression: transform.position.speed

expressions.name: Expose Layer Velocity Expression
expressions.description: Outputs the velocity (change in position over time) of a layer. Useful for triggering effects based on speed.
expressions.whenToUse: Trigger effects based on how fast an object moves - great for physics-based animation or speed-based visuals.
expressions.expression: transform.position.velocity

expressions.name: Automatic Fade In and Out with Sliders and Checkboxes
expressions.description: Fades a property in or out using checkbox toggles and custom sliders for duration, start, and final values. This removes the need for keyframes and makes the fade fully customizable.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for MOGRTs, templates, and automated scenes where designers want full UI control over fade animations.

expressions.name: Falling Snow Animation
expressions.description: A plugin-free particle system simulation that moves layers from top to bottom with randomized speed, wind sway, and start times. It includes advanced boundary logic to loop the elements perfectly, ensuring they don't pop off-screen.
expressions.whenToUse: The best way to create weather effects like rain or snow, or festive confetti backgrounds. Apply to one layer, duplicate it 50 times, and get a complex organic system instantly.

expressions.name: Flicker Effect on Layer In Point
expressions.description: Adds a flicker effect at the beginning of a layer's inPoint, fading in with random intensity. Easy to apply to Opacity or other properties for glitchy reveals.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for glitchy title intros, logo reveals, or simulating digital boot-up effects.

expressions.name: Flip Layer Horizontally Based on X Position
expressions.description: Flips a layer’s scale when it crosses the comp’s center.
expressions.whenToUse: Auto-flips layers when they move past the center of the screen, useful for characters, icons, or objects.
expressions.expression:
flip = (position[0] > thisComp.width / 2) ? [100, 100] : [-100, 100];
flip;

expressions.name: Flip Layer Vertically Based on Y Position
expressions.description: Flips a layer’s scale based on vertical position.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for character animations, object mirroring, or interface elements that need to flip when they move above or below a certain point in the composition.
expressions.expression:
flip = (position[1] > thisComp.height / 2) ? [100, 100] : [100, -100];
flip;

expressions.name: Font Size Based on Character Count
expressions.description: Shrinks font size automatically as the number of characters increases, preventing overflow or layout issues.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for templates where the text input can vary in length, such as dynamic names, titles, or personalized data fields.

expressions.name: Get Comp Name as Text
expressions.description: Outputs the current comp name inside a text layer. Great for template or placeholder projects.
expressions.whenToUse: Use as a labeling system for templates, versioning slates, or project organization placeholders.
expressions.expression: thisComp.name;

expressions.name: Gradient Ramp Fixed to Layer Edges
expressions.description: Keeps the gradient ramp fixed to the layer’s top and bottom edges, ensuring it moves seamlessly with the layer during animations.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for animating backgrounds, shapes, or titles where a consistent gradient needs to stay aligned with the layer as it moves.

expressions.name: Gradient Ramp Fixed to Layer Edges, Ignore Rotation
expressions.description: Keeps the gradient ramp aligned to the layer’s top and bottom edges, ignoring layer rotation to maintain a consistent gradient angle during animations.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for animated backgrounds, shapes, or titles where the gradient should stay fixed to the layer’s edges without rotating, preserving a stable gradient effect regardless of layer rotation.

expressions.name: Physics-Based Gravity Bounce Expression
expressions.description: Simulates gravity, air drag, bounce elasticity and ground friction.
expressions.whenToUse: Make any layer drop, bounce and slide like a real ball without keyframing each bounce.

expressions.name: Hanging Ornament Sway Animation
expressions.description: Generates a smooth, physics-based sine wave rotation that mimics an object dangling in a breeze. It automatically offsets the timing based on the layer index, ensuring a row of objects swings naturally rather than in robotic unison.
expressions.whenToUse: Essential for animating hanging decorations, lanterns, signs suspended by chains, or any object that needs to react to simulated wind.

expressions.name: Heartbeat Pulse Animation
expressions.description: Simulates a biologically accurate human cardiac rhythm (systole and diastole) on the Scale property. Unlike a simple sine wave, this expression creates the distinct "lub-dub" double-pulse motion found in medical EKG animations.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for medical visualizations, health-related UI dashboards, intense thriller titles, or adding a "living" breathing effect to character icons.

expressions.name: Ignore Parent Layer Rotation Expression
expressions.description: Ensures a layer’s rotation remains independent of its parent’s rotation.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for elements that need stable orientation despite parent layer rotations, like fixed icons or labels.
expressions.expression: value - parent.transform.rotation

expressions.name: Index Expression
expressions.description: Uses the layer's index in the timeline to control properties like position or rotation.
expressions.whenToUse: Placing each layer 50 pixels apart for a grid layout.
expressions.expression: index * 30

expressions.name: Inherit Parent Opacity
expressions.description: Connects a layer’s opacity to its parent layer’s opacity value.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful in lower-thirds or other animated text elements that fade in and out with the parent layer.
expressions.expression: (hasParent) ? parent.opacity : value;

expressions.name: Inherit Rotation from Nearest Layer
expressions.description: Finds the closest layer in the comp and copies its rotation in real time. The closest object controls how this layer rotates.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for swarm, flock, or system animations where objects orient toward nearby elements - also great for connecting elements or auto-aligned labels.

expressions.name: Keyframe Value Control with Sliders
expressions.description: This After Effects expression allows you to control keyframe values dynamically using sliders, preserving Graph Editor easing for smooth animations.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for projects where you need to adjust start and end values of animations on the fly without manually changing keyframes.

expressions.name: Layer Linking Expression
expressions.description: Links a layer’s position to another layer’s position.
expressions.whenToUse: Linking a child layer’s position to its parent with a slight offset to create a trailing effect.
expressions.expression: thisComp.layer("OtherLayer").position

expressions.name: LookAt Expression in 3D space
expressions.description: Rotates an object to always face another object.
expressions.whenToUse: You want a layer (such as a 3D object or camera) to always face another moving object (the target layer)
expressions.expression:
targetLayer = thisComp.layer("Target");
lookAt(thisComp.layer("Point").position, targetLayer.position)

expressions.name: LookAt Expression in 2D Space
expressions.description: Directs a layer’s orientation towards another layer, as in a “look at” function.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for creating interaction effects, like eyes or arrows that follow a moving object.

expressions.name: LoopIn Specific Number of Keyframes
expressions.description: Loops only the first few keyframes, creating a repeated beginning animation.
expressions.whenToUse: Handy for creating dynamic intro animations, where the start of the animation needs to repeat.
expressions.expression: loopIn("cycle",1)

expressions.name: Loop Mask Animation Expression
expressions.description: Loops a mask path animation continuously from the first to the last keyframe, ideal for repetitive mask-based effects.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for looping animations on raster images, videos, or shapes when track mattes aren’t practical.

expressions.name: LoopOut Continue Expression
expressions.description: Extends the animation beyond the last keyframe, maintaining the final movement’s direction and speed.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for animations that should continue smoothly beyond their last keyframe, like gradual fade-outs or growing/scaling effects.
expressions.expression: loopOut("continue")

expressions.name: LoopOut Cycle Expression
expressions.description: Loops the animation back to the first keyframe after the last one.
expressions.whenToUse: Looping the position of a bouncing ball to repeat its motion indefinitely without adding more keyframes.
expressions.expression: loopOut("cycle")

expressions.name: LoopOut Duration Control Expression
expressions.description: Adds a duration limit to loopOut, allowing a specified time for the looping effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for animating short loops with controlled timings, like flickering lights or pulsating effects.
expressions.expression: loopOutDuration("cycle",1)

expressions.name: LoopOut Offset Expression
expressions.description: Repeats the keyframe animation, offsetting each cycle by the difference between the last two keyframes. This creates a cumulative effect where each repetition builds on the previous one.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for creating staggered animations, like a row of bouncing balls or objects moving forward in a cascading pattern. Each cycle builds on the last, ideal for effects where movement needs to accumulate over time.
expressions.expression: loopOut("offset")

expressions.name: LoopOut PingPong Expression
expressions.description: Loops time-remapped footage back and forth.
expressions.whenToUse: Animating the position of an object in a cosine wave pattern, creating a back-and-forth motion.
expressions.expression: loopOut("pingpong")

expressions.name: LoopOut Specific Number of Keyframes
expressions.description: Loops only the last few keyframes, creating repeated animations within a set range.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for looping specific motion sequences, such as repetitive character movements or logo animations.
expressions.expression: loopOut("cycle",1)

expressions.name: Loop Path
expressions.description: Loops a property's animation, optionally creating a "ping-pong" effect where the animation plays forward and backward alternately.
expressions.whenToUse: Use this to have an object (like a car or airplane) continuously follow a looping path, such as driving around a track or flying in a circular route, without needing to manually repeat keyframes.

expressions.name: Looping Wiggle
expressions.description: Creates a seamless, looping wiggle effect that smoothly transitions between the start and end points, ensuring the motion resets every specified duration.
expressions.whenToUse: Use this on the Position property of an object (like a floating balloon or drifting cloud) to make it gently move up and down in a looping, natural manner. This expression ensures the wiggle effect loops seamlessly every 3 seconds, preventing abrupt jumps.

expressions.name: Maintain Scale While Parented Expression
expressions.description: Ensures a layer’s scale stays consistent even when its parent layer’s scale changes.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for maintaining the original size of elements within a hierarchy, like text or UI components.

expressions.name: Maintain Stroke Width in 3D Space
expressions.description: Keeps stroke width visually consistent regardless of the layer’s distance from the camera in 3D space. Note: Requires an active Camera layer for proper functionality.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for 3D projects where stroke width consistency is critical, such as motion graphics with line animations.

expressions.name: Maintain Stroke Width During Scaling
expressions.description: Keeps the stroke width consistent even when the layer is scaled, similar to vector graphics in Illustrator.
expressions.whenToUse: Essential for icons or shapes where stroke width consistency is key, regardless of layer scaling.

expressions.name: Matrix-Style Random Letters Animation
expressions.description: Generates animated grids of random A-Z letters. Fully dynamic with speed and layout controls.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for cyberpunk HUDs, abstract data visualizations, or animated typography experiments.

expressions.name: Matrix-Style Binary Numbers Animation
expressions.description: Dynamically creates a vertical grid of changing 0s and 1s. Customizable rows, columns, and animation speed.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for hacker-themed motion design, sci-fi intros, or digital rain effects.

expressions.name: Neon Light Flicker
expressions.description: Simulates a faulty or dying light source by randomly switching opacity between a "dim" and "fully on" state. Unlike a standard strobe, this uses probability logic to create an erratic, glitchy, and organic electrical rhythm.
expressions.whenToUse: Use this to create moody cyberpunk titles, horror movie intros, or broken shop signs where a bulb acts as if it has a bad electrical connection.

expressions.name: Number Counter With Separators
expressions.description: Formats a Slider Control value to two decimal places and adds thousands separators using periods.
expressions.whenToUse: Neatly formats large financial figures (e.g., "1.500.000") from a slider for on-screen display.

expressions.name: Oscillate Expression
expressions.description: Similar to the sine wave but with cosine, making an oscillation effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Creating a simple sine wave motion for a bouncing object or pendulum effect.
expressions.expression: Math.cos(time * 2) * 50

expressions.name: Overshoot Expression
expressions.description: Adds an overshoot or bounce-back effect after an animation.
expressions.whenToUse: Adding an overshoot effect to the scale property, causing it to bounce back slightly after reaching its final value.
expressions.expression: value + (value - valueAtTime(time - 0.1)) * 2

expressions.name: Parent Position Offset Expression
expressions.description: Offsets a layer’s position relative to its parent.
expressions.whenToUse: Offsetting a child layer’s position by 100 pixels relative to its parent.
expressions.expression: parent.position + [100, 100]

expressions.name: Parent Rotation Expression
expressions.description: Links the rotation to the parent layer with an additional 45-degree offset.
expressions.whenToUse: Adding 45 degrees to the parent layer’s rotation to ensure the child rotates at an offset angle.
expressions.expression: parent.rotation + 45

expressions.name: Parent Scale Expression
expressions.description: Adds to a parent layer’s scale by a fixed value.
expressions.whenToUse: Increasing the scale of a child layer by 10% compared to its parent layer.
expressions.expression: parent.scale + [10, 10]

expressions.name: Point To A Layer
expressions.description: Calculates the angle between two layers and points one to another.
expressions.whenToUse: Aligning a layer to always face a target layer.

expressions.name: PosterizeTime Expression
expressions.description: Forces a layer to refresh only at a set frame rate.
expressions.whenToUse: Forcing a layer to update at 12 frames per second to create a stop-motion effect.
expressions.expression:
posterizeTime(12);
value;

expressions.name: Create Procedural Candle Flame
expressions.description: Generates a vector teardrop shape that deforms realistically using Perlin noise. This mimics the physics of fire flickering and bending in the wind without requiring simulation plugins or raster footage.
expressions.whenToUse: Use this to create stylized, animated fire for 2D explainer videos, holiday candle illustrations, or fireplace animations where you need a lightweight, scalable vector element.

expressions.name: Create Procedural Gear Path
expressions.description: Generates a fully procedural gear shape using sliders for tooth count, gear radius, and tooth height. You can easily customize the look by tweaking slider values without touching the path manually.
expressions.whenToUse: Quickly generate animated gear shapes for motion graphics, infographics, or technical explainers without drawing or keyframing paths by hand.

expressions.name: Create Procedural North Star Shape
expressions.description: Mathematically plots a 4-pointed star path with elongated vertical tails. This procedural geometry allows you to create sparkles, gleams, and celestial bodies without manually drawing masks.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for creating magical particle systems, nativity scene skies, or highlighting key elements in a motion graphics composition with a stylized "ting" or flash.

expressions.name: Create Procedural Spiral Path
expressions.description: Generates a fully procedural spiral path in After Effects with precise control over radius, number of turns, and point density. The path updates dynamically as you tweak the sliders, giving you flexible, customizable spirals without manually drawing shapes.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for data visualizations, hypnotic motion backgrounds, generative art, or dynamic motion graphics where you need smooth, customizable spiral animations.

expressions.name: Rainbow Color Cycle
expressions.description: Automatically loops the layer’s fill or stroke through the entire RGB spectrum using HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) math. This creates a seamless, chromatic color shift without needing keyframes or gradient effects.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for creating psychedelic backgrounds, RGB gaming keyboard aesthetics, or dynamic, shifting gradients in abstract motion graphics.

expressions.name: Random Expression
expressions.description: Generates random values within a specified range.
expressions.whenToUse: Setting the opacity of multiple objects to random values between 0 and 100.
expressions.expression: random(0, 100)

expressions.name: Random Color Expression
expressions.description: Generates a random color for the layer within the RGB spectrum.
expressions.whenToUse: Randomly generating a color within the RGB range for a flashing light effect.

expressions.name: Random Flicker Animation
expressions.description: Creates a looping flicker effect based on random intervals and durations. Adjustable via min/max flicker and interval settings.
expressions.whenToUse: Create flickering neon signs, horror transitions, or simulate faulty tech screens.

expressions.name: Random Position Expression
expressions.description: Randomizes a layer’s position within a specified range.
expressions.whenToUse: Randomizing the position of a layer within a 200-pixel range in both X and Y directions.

expressions.name: Random Rotation Expression
expressions.description: Randomizes the rotation of a layer between 0 and 360 degrees.
expressions.whenToUse: Randomizing the rotation of layers in a starburst pattern, between 0 and 360 degrees.
expressions.expression: random(360)

expressions.name: Random Seeded Color Expression
expressions.description: Generates random colors consistently based on the layer's index.
expressions.whenToUse: Generating random colors consistently for text layers, ensuring each layer gets a unique color.
expressions.expression:
seedRandom(index, true);
random([0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1])

expressions.name: Repeat Text Expression
expressions.description: Loops a string multiple times based on a number input.
expressions.whenToUse: Automates text repetition, ideal for creating scrolling text effects or pattern-based typography.
expressions.expression: repeat(0); // Replace 0 with a number

expressions.name: Replace Spaces with New Line Expression
expressions.description: Converts spaces in text to line breaks, effectively creating new rows.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for automating multi-line text layouts in templates or data-driven projects.
expressions.expression: text.sourceText.replace(/ /gi,”\r”)

expressions.name: Replace Text Expression
expressions.description: This expression replaces specific characters within a text layer, automating text modifications without manual intervention.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for dynamically replacing words, letters, or symbols in a text layer - great for video versioning and automated text updates where manual edits aren’t possible.

expressions.name: Responsive Rectangle Based on Comp Size
expressions.description: Automatically sets a rectangle’s size to match the full dimensions of the composition. Plug it into the Size property of a shape layer rectangle.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for creating full-screen backgrounds, safe zones, responsive overlays, or any layout element that needs to stretch exactly across the comp.
expressions.expression:
var c = thisComp;
[c.width, c.height]

expressions.name: Responsive Text Box for Two Text Layers
expressions.description: Automatically adjusts a background rectangle size to fit two stacked text layers. Considers padding and distance between texts.
expressions.whenToUse: Auto-resize text containers for lower-thirds, dual-line titles, or caption panels.

expressions.name: Responsive Text Layout Based on Composition Width
expressions.description: Automatically adjusts the width of a text box based on the composition’s width. The text scales responsively without any sliders — fully adaptive and resolution-independent.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for video templates and automation setups with multiple aspect ratios. Ensures text always fits within the comp without needing to adjust anything manually across versions.

expressions.name: Responsive Text Layout (with Slider Controls)
expressions.description: Simulates responsive text box layouts like in Figma or web design tools. Lets you control and animate the width of the text box using a slider, and automatically scales the font and line spacing to fit cleanly.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for creating dynamic titles, captions, or UI layouts where you want to control the text container width manually. Great for building resizable lower-thirds or templates with flexible layouts.

expressions.name: Rolling Ball Expression
expressions.description: Links the position of a layer to a different property, like rotation.
expressions.whenToUse: Automatically rolling a ball that has position keyframes.
expressions.expression: thisLayer.transform.position[0] * 0.8

expressions.name: Row Counter for Text Layers
expressions.description: Counts the number of rows in a text layer, adjusting dynamically based on font size and leading (line spacing).
expressions.whenToUse: Great for automating layouts where the number of text rows affects the design, such as captions, paragraphs, or dynamic subtitles.

expressions.name: Scale Based On Distance
expressions.description: Calculates the distance between two layers and then affects a property based on it.
expressions.whenToUse: Scaling an object based on its distance from another object in the scene.

expressions.name: Scale from Start to End of Composition
expressions.description: Gradually increases or decreases a layer’s scale from the start to the end of the comp. It works automatically over the full timeline.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for looping animations, slow zoom effects, or background scaling.

expressions.name: Pulse Scale Animation
expressions.description: Creates a smooth, looping scale pulse using a sine wave to simulate a bounce or heartbeat effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Use it for buttons, callouts, or background elements that need to draw subtle attention.

expressions.name: Scale Up Near Another Layer Expression
expressions.description: Scales an object based on its proximity to another layer.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for interactive animations, like UI buttons that grow as a cursor approaches.

expressions.name: SeedRandom Expression
expressions.description: Generates random numbers consistently based on the seed value.
expressions.whenToUse: Ensuring random values for each layer stay consistent over time based on their index.
expressions.expression:
seedRandom(index, true);
value + random([-50, -50], [50, 50]);

expressions.name: Show Aspect Ratio
expressions.description: Calculates your composition’s aspect ratio by finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) between width and height, then displays the simplified format like 16:9, 1:1, or 9:16. Ideal for workflows involving multiple deliverable formats where maintaining correct ratios is crucial.
expressions.whenToUse: Quickly confirm and display aspect ratios in adaptive templates, after effects automation, and multi-format video exports.

expressions.name: Show Composition Duration
expressions.description: Automatically calculates your composition’s total length and formats it into a readable minutes:seconds:frames structure.
expressions.whenToUse: Display the total duration of your video in templates, metadata overlays, or preview exports without manual updates.

expressions.name: Show Composition Info
expressions.description: Displays real-time composition information directly inside a text layer. The expression reads properties like duration, frame rate, resolution, layer count, and current time from your active comp and updates them dynamically. Includes optional checkboxes to toggle each stat on or off for a fully customizable overlay.
expressions.whenToUse: Display live composition metadata for previews or template validation without opening comp settings.

expressions.name: Show Frame Rate
expressions.description: Fetches the active comp’s frame duration and converts it into frames per second (FPS), automatically formatting it to match whole or fractional frame rates. This ensures accurate display whether you’re working at 23.976, 24, 29.97, 30, or 60 FPS.
expressions.whenToUse: Display the frame rate directly inside your video for metadata overlays, debugging multiple deliverables, or automated template workflows.
expressions.expression:
fps = 1 / thisComp.frameDuration;
fps % 1 === 0 ? fps.toFixed(0) : fps.toFixed(2);

expressions.name: Show Layer Count
expressions.description: Counts the total number of layers in the current composition and displays it dynamically in a text layer. Whenever you add or remove layers, the displayed number updates instantly, making it perfect for automated templates and project debugging.
expressions.whenToUse: Display (calculate) total layer counts in metadata overlays or track layer-heavy comps at a glance.
expressions.expression: thisComp.numLayers;

expressions.name: Show Resolution
expressions.description: Reads the active composition’s width and height in pixels and outputs the resolution in a “1920×1080” format. Updates in real-time, so if you switch to a different comp size, the displayed resolution adjusts automatically.
expressions.whenToUse: Add live resolution metadata to templates, manage multi-resolution deliverables, or debug responsive motion graphics.
expressions.expression: thisComp.width + "x" + thisComp.height;

expressions.name: Procedural Sine Wave Line Expression
expressions.description: Uses a sine function across many points, with sliders for wave height, wavelength and total length, then draws the path.
expressions.whenToUse: Like Wave effect but way better. Quickly generate wavy lines for backgrounds, audio visualizers or motion-graphic flourishes.

expressions.name: Sine Wave Motion Expression
expressions.description: Creates a sine wave motion on a property, such as opacity.
expressions.whenToUse: Animating the opacity of an object to pulse over time using a sine wave.
expressions.expression: Math.sin(time * 2) * 100

expressions.name: Single Corner Radius After Effects Expression
expressions.description: Lets you dial in a separate roundness slider for each corner and then builds the shape path with proper Beziér curves.
expressions.whenToUse: Draw one rectangle but round only the corners you want, without extra shape layers or masks.

expressions.name: Smooth Expression
expressions.description: Smoothens out the jittery motion of a property over time.
expressions.whenToUse: Smoothing out the jittery motion of a handheld camera by averaging out its position over time.
expressions.expression: smooth(width = 0.2, samples = 5)

expressions.name: Snap to Layer or Comp Corners
expressions.description: Snaps any layer exactly where you want it - to the edges, corners, or center of your comp, or perfectly aligned with another layer. It updates automatically if the target layer moves or changes size, and you can fine-tune the position with simple X and Y offset controls.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for neatly lining up text, graphics, or logos without manually dragging them around. You can make lower-thirds stay aligned to a box, keep captions centered under a video, or build layouts that stay tidy no matter how your layers change.

expressions.name: Split Text Layer by Separator
expressions.description: Splits a text layer’s name or content into two or more parts based on a separator (e.g., hyphen, colon, or space) and extracts either the first or second part. Note: You can experiment with different separators by changing the character inside the brackets (” “). To split into more than two parts, follow the same method.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for automating text-based workflows where layers have structured names like “Title - Subtitle” or “Section: Topic,” allowing you to use each part independently.
expressions.expression:
thisComp.layer("Main Text Layer").text.sourceText.split(" ") [0] // First part
thisComp.layer("Main Text Layer").text.sourceText.split(" ") [1] // Second part
thisComp.layer("Main Text Layer").text.sourceText.split(" ") [2] // Third part (this can continue indefinitely, depending on how many parts you need)

expressions.name: Squash and Stretch Animation Expression
expressions.description: Creates a squash-and-stretch effect at the start of a layer’s timeline, with adjustable duration, speed, and amplitude.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for adding a lively, cartoony effect to bouncing or landing animations.

expressions.name: Strobe Light Expression
expressions.description: Creates a strobe light effect by toggling between values.
expressions.whenToUse: Making a text layer's opacity blink between 100% and 0% every second.

expressions.name: Swinging Pendulum Animation
expressions.description: Simulates the motion of a swinging pendulum with decaying amplitude over time, mimicking realistic physical movement.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for creating physics-based effects or adding organic motion to objects like hanging signs, swinging decorations, or other elements that need natural oscillation.

expressions.name: Tapered Wave Line Expression
expressions.description: Builds a sine wave whose height tapers off based on a “bias” slider (peak at left, center, or right) and draws the shape path.
expressions.whenToUse: Animate a wave that fades in or out toward one side for stylized trails or sound-wave graphics.

expressions.name: Text Change Based on Layer Position
expressions.description: Checks where your layer sits on screen and updates its text to match which quadrant it’s in.
expressions.whenToUse: Auto-label elements like “Top Left” or “Bottom Right” as you drag them around the comp. Handy for interactive mockups.

expressions.name: Text Glitch Effect Expression
expressions.description: Applies a real-time text glitch effect by randomly corrupting characters each frame using ASCII symbols, Unicode blocks, duplicates, and case flips. Sliders let you control glitch speed and corruption intensity. *For best results, use fonts like Arial that support a wide range of symbols.
expressions.whenToUse: Create glitchy titles, cyberpunk-style typography, or hacking-inspired motion graphics with full control over speed and distortion.

expressions.name: Text Scramble Reveal Animation
expressions.description: Seeds a random charset each frame and gradually replaces random letters with the target text based on a linear progress tied to time and inPoint.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for sci-fi titles, glitch-style reveals, or data-driven infographics where you reveal text over time with randomized characters.

expressions.name: Time Expression
expressions.description: Creates continuous motion like rotation or movement over time.
expressions.whenToUse: Rotating an object at a steady rate over time by applying it to the Rotation property.
expressions.expression: time * 100

expressions.name: Time-Remap Control Expression
expressions.description: Slows down time remap for a layer to 50%.
expressions.whenToUse: Slowing down a video clip by half its speed using time remapping.
expressions.expression: timeRemap * 0.5

expressions.name: Timecode Counter with Drop Frame Support
expressions.description: Displays a timecode counter, formatted correctly with hours, minutes, seconds, and frames.
expressions.whenToUse: Used for creating on-screen timecode displays that match frame rates accurately.

expressions.name: ToComp Expression
expressions.description: Converts the position of a 3D layer to 2D comp space.
expressions.whenToUse: Use when you want the 2D element to track the position of the 3D layer but stay flat and readable without 3D distortions.
expressions.expression: toComp(anchorPoint)

expressions.name: Toggle Layer Visibility with a Dropdown Menu
expressions.description: This expression links opacity to a dropdown menu, allowing users to toggle visibility based on selection.
expressions.whenToUse: Easily turn layers on or off using a dropdown menu for better control over variations in templates.
expressions.expression:
dropdown = thisLayer.effect("Dropdown Menu Control")("Menu");
dropdown == 1 ? 100 : 0;

expressions.name: Trigger Animation with Markers
expressions.description: Starts an animation sequence each time a marker is encountered on a specified layer.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for triggering UI animations on click or hover, like button highlights or tooltips.

expressions.name: Unique Snowflake Generator
expressions.description: A complex generative art script that uses branching algorithms to draw a unique, crystalline vector path. It uses the layer index as a random seed, meaning every duplicate of the layer will generate a completely different fractal design.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for winter-themed motion graphics where you need variety. Instead of using the same asset repeatedly, you can generate an infinite number of unique ice crystals instantly.

expressions.name: ValueAtTime Expression
expressions.description: Offsets animation by retrieving a property value from a specific time.
expressions.whenToUse: Delaying the position animation of a layer so it follows another layer with a slight lag.
expressions.expression: thisComp.layer("LayerName").transform.position.valueAtTime(time - 1)

expressions.name: Value Relative to Time Expression
expressions.description: Gradually changes a value over time within a specified range.
expressions.whenToUse: Gradually changing the scale of an object from 0 to 100% over 5 seconds.
expressions.expression: linear(time, 0, 10, 0, 100)

expressions.name: Layer Visibility Based on Day of the Week
expressions.description: Reads today’s weekday from your computer clock and sets layer opacity to 100% only if it matches your chosen day.
expressions.whenToUse: Show or hide graphics automatically on specific weekdays - ideal for daily promos or social-media templates used in After Effects automation.

expressions.name: Wiggle Expression
expressions.description: Adds randomness (e.g., jitter) to a property. The first number is frequency, second is amplitude.
expressions.whenToUse: Creating a subtle shake in a text layer to simulate a hand-held camera effect.
expressions.expression: wiggle(2, 50)

expressions.name: Wiggle One Dimension Only Expression
expressions.description: Applies a wiggle effect to only one dimension (e.g., X or Y) of a layer’s position.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for subtle jitter effects on text or images that should only move horizontally or vertically.
expressions.expression:
w = wiggle(2,50);
[w[0],value[1]]

expressions.name: Wiggle Based on Speed
expressions.description: Adds more wiggle the faster the layer moves by linking wiggle amplitude to position speed in real time.
expressions.whenToUse: Ideal for dynamic particles, trailing effects, or elements that should “shake” only when in motion.

expressions.name: Wiggle with Seed Expression
expressions.description: Creates a wiggle effect with a consistent seed for randomization.
expressions.whenToUse: Creating a wiggle effect on position with a set seed, ensuring the randomness is consistent across renders.
expressions.expression:
seedRandom(index, true);
wiggle(2, 50)

expressions.name: Word Counter for Text Layers
expressions.description: Counts the number of words in a text layer and displays the result.
expressions.whenToUse: Useful for dynamically counting words in scripts, subtitles, or infographic animations.
expressions.expression:
myText = thisComp.layer("Source").text.sourceText;
myText.split(" ").length;

expressions.name: Letter-by-Letter Write-On Text Animation
expressions.description: Animates text layer visibility by revealing letters one at a time for a typewriter-style effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Great for animating headlines, intros, or coding-themed sequences where text needs to appear letter-by-letter.

expressions.name: Word-by-Word Write-On Text Animation
expressions.description: Animates text layer visibility by revealing words one at a time, simulating a typewriter or write-on effect.
expressions.whenToUse: Perfect for captions, subtitles, or kinetic typography where text is revealed incrementally.

expressions.name: Procedural Zig-Zag Line Expression
expressions.description: Evenly spaces a set number of points along a line and alternates their Y-positions up/down to form a zig-zag.
expressions.whenToUse: Create customizable zig-zag dividers or energy lines in seconds.
